entries.baf26ddc65a8fbad: Its medium-term management policy, covering the fiscal year ending March 2027 as its final year, carries the slogan "Improve the corporate structure and build a strong, growing company," and it states that it aims to build a corporate structure that secures stable earnings unaffected by economic fluctuations.
